description: This Kotlin source file defines the ContentInfoActivity class, which is an Android activity responsible for displaying content details such as poster image, title, and description, fetched from specific API endpoints. It manages user interactions like starting playback through a 'Watch now' button, which triggers additional API calls to retrieve media URLs and launch a media player activity. The class includes API communication logic, UI updating, and intent handling.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays detailed information about a specific content item, fetches its info from a remote API, and allows the user to start playback.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up views, loads the poster image, and triggers fetchInfo with the content ID.

methods.name: fetchInfo
methods.description: Fetches content details such as title and description from the API and updates the UI.

methods.name: onWatchNowClicked
methods.description: Handles the 'Watch now' button click, calls the playback API, retrieves the media URL, and starts the PlayerActivity.
